newsitem.title: Switzerland: Swiss franc moves lower against dollar, mark.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc moves lower against dollar, mark.

text.p: 1640 GMT - The Swiss franc closed lower as weak domestic fundamentals and dollar strength continued to weigh on the currency, foreign exchange dealers said.
News that Swiss GDP contracted by 0.7 percent in the third quarter after a provisional 0.9 percent decline served to remind the market of the franc's poor fundamentals, one dealer said.
The franc was also pressured by comments from Swiss National Bank (SNB) board member Jean-Pierre Roth who said the SNB was pleased with recent franc developments.
